title: 第二十三章 熊大熊二第二十四章 演到你流泪
slug: 武道长生从大离第一纨绔开始

read2（）;“吼！”
顾尘风远远望见，先前被四方门围困的赤焰蛮熊。
此刻浑身染血，从远处狂奔而来。
一面奔跑，它还不断朝那变异巨熊，发出低吼。
见到赤焰蛮熊，变异巨熊疯狂嗜血的眸光中，竟然露出一丝人性化的惊喜神情。
口中的赤光也迅速消失。
换做其他人，见到这一幕，恐怕会摸不着头脑。
但顾尘风却能够听懂兽语。
他亲耳听到，那赤焰蛮熊对变异巨熊呼喊。
“大哥，不要伤害它，是这个人类救了我。”
这一刻，顾尘风有种想给赤焰蛮熊，磕一个的冲动。
熊哥，你来的太及时了！
此前他出手解救赤焰蛮熊，只是想让它帮忙，搞定四方门的其他人。
哪曾想，这位还有这么彪悍的大哥。
听了自己弟弟的话，熊大哥看向顾尘风的目光，果然变得清澈。
待到熊小弟奔到它面前，就见熊大哥一巴掌呼过去。
“嘭……！”
熊小弟被这一巴掌，扇得翻滚了好几圈。
却听熊大哥惊喜道：“小弟，你没事吧，大哥真担心死你了！”

熊小弟一骨碌爬起来，朝熊大哥大腿上拍了一巴掌，激动道。
“大哥，我没事，只是受了些伤而已，多亏这个人类救了我。”
两头巨熊，你一巴掌，我一巴掌的交流方式。
看得顾尘风眼皮直跳。
得亏它们皮糙肉厚，不然高低得拍死几个好兄弟。
兄弟俩交流片刻，顾尘风便知道，自己这条命算是保住了。
果然，片刻后。
两只庞然大物转身，面朝自己。
竟是一起抱着前掌，有些滑稽地朝自己作揖，以示感谢。
顾尘风见状，也是赶忙抱拳还礼。
“俗话说救熊一命，胜造七级浮屠，两位熊兄，不必言谢。”
双方无法交流，随意客套一番后。
熊大便带着熊二，朝着远处密林行去。
看着两尊庞然大物，消失在密林深处，顾尘风刚松了一口气。
“咚咚……！”
大地突然震动。
就见熊大庞大如山的身形，又跃出密林，转眼间冲到了自己身前。
顾尘风心中一紧。
却见熊大随手一抛，将一块用巨大林片，包裹的东西，扔到了自己面前。

read2(); "Roar!"
Gu Chenfeng saw from a distance the Red Flame Bear that was previously surrounded by the Sifang Gate.
At this moment, his body was covered in blood and he was running wildly from a distance.
While running, it kept roaring at the mutated giant bear.
Seeing the red flame savage bear, the mutated giant bear's crazy and bloodthirsty eyes showed a hint of human surprise.
The red light in his mouth also quickly disappeared.
If it were anyone else, they would probably be confused when they see this scene.
But Gu Chenfeng could understand the animal language.
He heard with his own ears that the red-flame savage bear shouted to the mutated giant bear.
"Brother, don't hurt it. This human saved me."
At this moment, Gu Chenfeng had the urge to kowtow to Chiyan Savage Bear.
Brother Xiong, you came just in time!
He had previously rescued the Red Flame Barbarian Bear, just to ask it to help him get rid of the other people in the Sifang Sect.
I never thought that this man would have such a tough brother.
After listening to his brother's words, Brother Xiong's eyes turned clear when he looked at Gu Chenfeng.
When Brother Bear ran up to it, Brother Bear slapped him and called him over.
"Bang...!"
Little Brother Xiong was slapped and rolled several times.
But I heard Brother Xiong say in surprise: "Brother, are you okay? Brother is really worried about you!"
Little Brother Xiong jumped up, slapped Brother Xiong on the thigh, and said excitedly.
"Brother, I'm fine, I'm just injured. Thanks to this human being for saving me."
Two giant bears, one slap for you and one slap for me.
Gu Chenfeng's eyelids jumped.
Fortunately, they have rough skin and thick flesh, otherwise they would kill several good brothers.
After the two brothers communicated for a while, Gu Chenfeng knew that his life was saved.
Sure enough, after a while.
The two behemoths turned around and faced themselves.
They actually held their front paws together and bowed to themselves in a funny way to express their gratitude.
When Gu Chenfeng saw this, he hurriedly returned the gesture with fists in his hands.
"As the saying goes, saving a bear's life is better than building a seven-level pagoda. Two bear brothers, no need to say thank you."
The two parties were unable to communicate, and after some casual politeness.
Xiong Shi took Xiong Er and headed towards the dense forest in the distance.
Gu Chenfeng just breathed a sigh of relief as he watched the two behemoths disappear deep into the jungle.
"Dong dong...!"
The ground suddenly shook.
He saw the bear's huge body as big as a mountain leaping out of the dense forest again and rushing in front of him in the blink of an eye.
Gu Chenfeng's heart tightened.
But he saw Xiong Da throw something wrapped in a huge forest piece in front of him.
